name: Breathwork
description: Slow, gentle breathing at around 6 breaths per minute. It may help you feel calmer. It is not a treatment for any medical or mental health condition.

steps.text: Sit or lie comfortably and let your shoulders drop.
Breathe in gently through your nose, then breathe out slowly, at around 6 breaths per minute.
Let the out-breath be a little longer than the in-breath if that feels comfortable.
Continue for as long as feels comfortable, then return to normal breathing.
If you feel dizzy, lightheaded or uncomfortable, stop and breathe normally.

claims.text: Slow breathing at around 6 breaths per minute may help you feel calmer.
An out-breath longer than the in-breath may feel more relaxing.

safety_notes: Not medical advice and not a treatment for any condition.
Stop if you feel dizzy, lightheaded, tingling or short of breath.
Do not practise while driving or in water.
If you have a heart, lung or anxiety condition, ask a clinician before starting.
